nodes.label: D1 Floating-Window Tab Close Discarded Every Other Panel
nodes.source_file: docs/releases/v0.21.0/WP21.0K Docking Keyboard Closure and Real-Shell Verification.md
nodes.rationale: A floating window's host renders a synthetic single-window tree; every gesture it applied produced another single-window tree the controller adopted as the whole arrangement. Fixed by splicing the subtree back into its one window entry (AdoptSecondaryWindowSubtree). Present since WP 20.10D.

nodes.label: D2 Restored Focus Ring Never Drawn
nodes.source_file: docs/releases/v0.21.0/WP21.0K Docking Keyboard Closure and Real-Shell Verification.md
nodes.rationale: Focus() with NavigationMethod.Unspecified does not set Avalonia's :focus-visible - right for a mouse drag, wrong for a key the user pressed; a keyboard gesture now restores focus as keyboard focus.

nodes.label: D3 Shutdown Gate Did Not Run on the Rig
nodes.source_file: docs/releases/v0.21.0/WP21.0K Docking Keyboard Closure and Real-Shell Verification.md
nodes.rationale: No window manager on the Xvfb display, so WM_DELETE_WINDOW never reached MainWindow.Closing; App.cs never sets ShutdownMode so OnLastWindowClose applies and a floating window may outlive the main window - a shell-lifecycle question owed to Windows.
